parent_empirical_result.rule: The completed 211-species one-shot result is an immutable unconditional baseline. This protocol cannot rescue, rerun, retune, or reinterpret that result.

scientific_question: When does post-IBD spatial genetic differentiation become transferable across species, after requiring source species to share geographic support with the unseen target and then asking whether coarse lineage similarity adds further predictive value?

source_and_panels.development_panel: first 250 eligible species under the frozen conditional ranking after excluding the prior fresh panel
source_and_panels.confirmatory_panel: next 250 eligible species under the same ranking
source_and_panels.development_role: geometry/taxonomy and synthetic-method development only; empirical nucleotide identity remains permanently closed
source_and_panels.confirmatory_role: future one-shot empirical conditional-transfer test only after all pre-outcome gates pass

geographic_conditioning.target_coverage_definition: fraction of target graph-edge midpoints whose nearest source graph-edge midpoint is <= 500 km
geographic_conditioning.unsupported_target_policy: prospectively unsupported for the conditional estimand; do not relax coverage or source-count thresholds after outcomes
geographic_conditioning.source_weighting_within_pool: equal total weight per selected training species, inherited from core TTF; equal weight within a species is divided over its frozen graph edges

primary_estimand.name: geographic_conditioning_increment
primary_estimand.per_target: Spearman(geographically conditioned prediction, target post-IBD turnover) - Spearman(unconditional prediction, target post-IBD turnover)
primary_estimand.panel_statistic: arithmetic mean of the paired increment across response-blind supported evaluation species
primary_estimand.baseline: the unchanged unconditional TTF field using all frozen training species
primary_estimand.inference: one-sided centered studentized bootstrap over held-out evaluation species
primary_estimand.positive_claim: Geographic co-coverage improves out-of-species prediction of post-IBD differentiation relative to the unconditional field.

secondary_estimand.name: same_order_increment_beyond_geography
secondary_estimand.source_in_pool: same geographic support rule as the primary estimand AND source order equals target order
secondary_estimand.per_target: Spearman(same-order + geographic prediction, target post-IBD turnover) - Spearman(geographic-only prediction, target post-IBD turnover)
secondary_estimand.panel_statistic: arithmetic mean of the paired increment across response-blind same-order-supported evaluation species
secondary_estimand.inference: one-sided centered studentized bootstrap over held-out evaluation species
secondary_estimand.interpretation: coarse lineage similarity adds transfer skill beyond geographic co-coverage; order is a proxy for biological similarity, not a direct measurement of dispersal ability or demographic history

excluded_estimands.same_family: not pursued because response-blind development support is too sparse for a panel-wide estimand
excluded_estimands.direct_dispersal_history: not claimed from taxonomy; a direct trait/history analysis would require a separately frozen external-data protocol

development_and_qualification.next_step: freeze synthetic private-null, geography-conditioned-positive, and order-conditioned-positive world generators; qualify Type-I and power on the development geometry before touching confirmatory character identity
development_and_qualification.type1_requirement: Wilson 95% upper rejection bound <= 0.10 under private lineage-specific residual structure
development_and_qualification.power_requirement: Wilson 95% lower rejection bound >= 0.80 for the predeclared positive-control world appropriate to each estimand
development_and_qualification.confirmatory_identity_opening_requires: development qualification PASS, confirmatory character-mask admissibility PASS, and exact confirmatory survivor-geometry requalification PASS

confirmatory_stopping_rules: do not inspect development-panel nucleotide identity
do not inspect confirmatory-panel nucleotide identity before all response-blind gates pass
do not alter support radius, 0.25 coverage threshold, minimum five source species, taxonomy rank, bandwidth, split, alpha, or bootstrap rule after confirmatory outcomes are opened
do not replace same-order with a finer or coarser taxonomic rank after seeing empirical transfer
do not use the new result to rewrite the completed unconditional one-shot result
claim_boundary: This study tests whether transferability is conditional on shared geographic support and, secondarily, coarse taxonomic order. It does not identify dispersal ability, historical range dynamics, or a causal mechanism unless those variables are introduced under a separate prospective protocol.
